title: Structure a 30-second Seedance ad as Problem → intervention → transformation →…
content:
Structure a 30-second Seedance ad as Problem → intervention → transformation → payoff to tell a complete ecommerce story in one sequence  
Generate a 30s native video in a single Seedance 2.5 generation to produce a full ad without stitching clips  
Use up to 50 multimodal references in Seedance 2.5 to maintain stronger product consistency across the ad  
Output native 4K in Seedance 2.5 when you need high-resolution, test-ready ecommerce ad creatives  
Follow the workflow Assets → Reference Ad → Full Video → Variations to create a base ad and then generate multiple test-ready variations
